reproducibility_gaps: No dependency manifest, Python/package versions, or installation/run workflow is supplied for the legacy TensorFlow/Keras/CuDNN stack.
Both entrypoints use a placeholder data directory and undefined save_path; PhyLSTM3 requests an absent dataset.
Both scripts contain undefined post-training loss variables, no results directory exists, and no checkpoint, log, saved prediction, or numeric tolerance is bundled.
The paper describes two fully connected layers per component, while all three PhyLSTM3 hidden Dense(100) statements are commented out and only the output Dense layers remain active.
Training/validation membership is reshuffled every epoch with no random seed.
The bundled MAT payload remained unopened and paper results were not recomputed.
notes: R1 preserves MIT-licensed source, substantial mathematical/architecture detail, one bundled dataset, and paper targets while withholding R2 because no substantially specified portable environment/install/entrypoint workflow exists.
